solver.message:
Implemented the reusable FlashlightPoint marker.

- `scripts/flashlight_point.gd` exposes `Priority { low, medium, high }`, `has_been_targeted`, and `reset_target_state()`.
- `scenes/flashlight_point.tscn` uses `Marker3D` and belongs to `FlashlightPoints`.
- `scenes/main.tscn` contains three instances directly under `Main`:

| Node | Position | Priority |
|---|---|---|
| FlashlightPoint | `(8.36166, 1.81915, -12.0301)` | medium |
| FlashlightPoint2 | `(-16.6577, 2.41884, -39.9426)` | low |
| FlashlightPoint3 | `(23.0185, 2.63927, -86.6948)` | high |

Validated in Godot 4.4.1 with runtime assertions and a captured visual frame.
